title: Adorable!
text: Adorable!. When I first opened this, I was a little confused and thought that maybe it was just a pillow cover. But no, it's a cover plus pillow. The pillow is separate but it is compressed and practically flat, so I didn't notice it at first. The cover is adorable. The alligator is so cute! This will make a nice addition to my daughter's room.
